RISK-001.title: Timezone correctness in danger date calculations
RISK-001.description: Billing happens in vendor timezone, but dangerDate/due sweep runs in fixed zone. Off-by-one means sweep fires after charge.
RISK-001.impact: Direct financial loss - most expensive bug in system
RISK-001.mitigation: Store vendor timezone with each trial, calculate danger dates in vendor timezone, run sweep with timezone-aware scheduling
acceptanceCriteria: Each trial record includes vendor timezone field
Danger date calculated in vendor timezone
Scheduled sweep runs in vendor timezone
Timezone-aware comparison for due date checks
Test with cross-timezone trials (UTC, PST, EST, etc.)

RISK-002.title: Sweep cadence vs billing time alignment
RISK-002.description: Once-daily sweep may be too coarse. Service bills at 00:30 their time, sweep runs at 09:00. 2-day buffer is only safety.
RISK-002.impact: Missed cancellation window if sweep cadence doesn't align with billing patterns
RISK-002.mitigation: Implement per-service sweep cadence based on billing time, tighten cadence for high-risk services, widen buffer for coarse cadence
acceptanceCriteria: Each service has billing time metadata
Sweep cadence calculated per service based on billing time
High-risk services have hourly sweeps near billing time
Test with services billing at different times

RISK-003.title: Cancellation verification missing
RISK-003.description: JobProof captured but no re-check that cancellation actually stuck (status flipped, confirmation received). "Submitted" ≠ "cancelled".
RISK-003.impact: False confidence in cancellation success, potential charges despite "successful" job
RISK-003.mitigation: Implement verification step that checks account status post-cancellation, scrape confirmation emails/numbers, retry on failure
acceptanceCriteria: Verification step after each cancellation job
Check account status via API or RPA
Escalate to manual if verification fails 3 times

RISK-004.title: Escalation timing and notification channel
RISK-004.description: manual_only and failed need notification with enough lead time for manual action. No notification channel wired (email/Slack/Notion).
RISK-004.impact: Silent failures lead to charges, no time to react manually
RISK-004.mitigation: Wire notification channels (email/Slack/Notion), implement lead time calculation, escalate based on urgency
acceptanceCriteria: Lead time calculation per service urgency
Escalation rules: manual_only = 24h notice, failed = immediate
Notification includes service, action needed, deadline

RISK-005.title: Credential storage for RPA cancellation
RISK-005.description: RPA cancellation requires login credentials. No design for encrypted storage, scoping, or boundary between Cloudflare worker and secret store.
RISK-005.impact: High-value secret exposure, security breach risk, credential management nightmare
RISK-005.mitigation: Design secure credential storage (Azure Key Vault), define Cloudflare worker boundary, implement encryption at rest/transit
acceptanceCriteria: Secret store architecture designed (Azure Key Vault)
Encryption at rest and in transit

RISK-006.title: Legal review of service ToS not completed
RISK-006.description: Rule is "nothing public until proven legal" but no per-service ToS classification, no virtual-card-decline backstop check against issuer terms.
RISK-006.impact: Legal liability, account bans, payment processor issues, violates own rule
RISK-006.mitigation: Classify per-service ToS (automated cancellation allowed?), check virtual card decline backstop, complete legal review before production
acceptanceCriteria: Production deployment blocked until legal sign-off

RISK-007.title: PII retention and deletion policy missing
RISK-007.description: Telemetry pseudonymized but no data-retention or deletion policy for stored trials, userIds, proofs - even for personal use.
RISK-007.impact: Data compliance issues, privacy concerns, data accumulation over time
RISK-007.mitigation: Define retention policy per data type, implement automatic deletion, add data export functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Data export functionality for GDPR compliance
Audit trail for data access and deletion

RISK-008.title: Idempotency of cancellation jobs
RISK-008.description: If sweep double-runs or job retries, can we double-submit cancellation? KV adapter has locks but trial→job dedup not proven.
RISK-008.impact: Double cancellation attempts, API rate limits, confusing status, potential account lockouts
RISK-008.mitigation: Implement job deduplication at trial level, add job idempotency keys, test double-run scenarios
acceptanceCriteria: Idempotency keys for each cancellation attempt

RISK-009.title: Quarantine review workflow not defined
RISK-009.description: QuarantineEvent exists in schema but no defined human review path for quarantined flows.
RISK-009.impact: Quarantined trials stuck in limbo, no way to recover valid trials, manual intervention required
RISK-009.mitigation: Define quarantine review workflow, create review queue, implement approval/rejection mechanism

RISK-010.title: "Keep this one" workflow missing
RISK-010.description: Sometimes you want to convert a trial. No clean way to mark "keep, don't cancel" - everything trends toward auto-cancel.
RISK-010.impact: Forced cancellation of desired trials, manual intervention required, poor user experience
RISK-010.mitigation: Add "keep" status flag, exclude from auto-cancel, implement conversion workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Conversion workflow from trial to paid

RISK-011.title: KV ↔ Notion sync not implemented
RISK-011.description: Trials DB is empty mirror until sync exists. KV is source of truth, Notion is human mirror, but no sync mechanism.
RISK-011.impact: Human oversight impossible, data inconsistency, no visibility into trial status
RISK-011.mitigation: Implement bidirectional KV ↔ Notion sync, define conflict resolution, add sync monitoring

RISK-012.title: Discovery review queue not built
RISK-012.description: Designed in Devin brief but not built. No human approval path for discovered trials before signup.
RISK-012.impact: Automated signup violates safety rails, no human oversight of trial selection
RISK-012.mitigation: Build discovery review queue, implement approval workflow, add trial signup gating

RISK-013.title: Canary testing on live KV not performed
RISK-013.description: 3 canary checks skipped, no end-to-end test against real sandbox service, no chaos/timeout testing of MYBROWSER contract.
RISK-013.impact: Production bugs discovered too late, MYBROWSER contract reliability unknown, no chaos testing
RISK-013.mitigation: Perform canary checks on live KV, implement end-to-end sandbox testing, add chaos/timeout testing
acceptanceCriteria: Canary checks completed on live KV

RISK-014.title: Alert receiver not wired
RISK-014.description: AlertRules schema exists but points at nothing. No alert delivery mechanism configured.
RISK-014.impact: Alerts generated but not delivered, no operational visibility, silent failures
RISK-014.mitigation: Wire alert receiver (email/Slack/Notion), configure alert routing, test alert delivery

RISK-015.title: Two-stack drift between Cloudflare and Azure
RISK-015.description: Cloudflare (orchestrator) + Azure (Runbook Operator) need clear owner-of-record and schema-version alignment or they'll diverge.
RISK-015.impact: Schema drift, inconsistent behavior, integration breakage, maintenance nightmare
RISK-015.mitigation: Define owner-of-record per stack, implement schema version alignment, add cross-stack integration tests
